title: Agent detection's process-chain boundary includes cargo-nextest; the susi-paths substrate-home test honours the hermetic wrapper
goal: Two defects found by running the local gate under nextest, hermetically (T-CLAUDECHARMINGCURIE-2). (1) tool_process_chain stops the ancestor walk at the first cargo/rustc/rustdoc process, so a developer's Claude/Codex shell above cargo is not mistaken for the wrapper under test. But cargo REPLACES itself with cargo-nextest (exec), so under nextest the boundary is never seen and the walk reaches 'bash /abs/.claude/worktrees/<name>/scripts/<x>.sh', whose script path contains 'claude': tasks_cli the_tool_in_the_process_tree_names_the_agent then fails with (agent CLAUDE) in every agent worktree - the standing 'fails only inside an agent process tree' note on four closed tasks' binary(tasks_cli) acceptances. cargo-nextest is a boundary too. (2) susi-paths tests::substrate_home_is_not_a_project_cwd asserts a pinned SUSI_HOME is the substrate home verbatim, which scripts/check-hermetic-tests.sh deliberately makes SusiDirs::instance_root() ignore (Mandate 52); it failed the old branch-push hermetic step for any push touching susi-paths. It should ask instance_root(), not re-read the env.
